opening.argument: The video makes a direct investment pitch for Polybius by tying token ownership to recurring financial returns: holders are told they have the ability to receive “20% of 20% of Polybius Bank's dividends,” while the purchase is presented as offering a return received every year. The invitation is practical, not merely theoretical: viewers are told “you can invest anytime now,” and the demonstration enters 0.05 BTC to buy tokens. The transaction screen reinforces that this is a cryptocurrency payment request, displaying 0.0500000 BTC in exchange for 12.29215 PLBT. The pitch also adds urgency through a first-day ICO benefit, promising investors can earn 25% more tokens.
